resources.string: Separate opt-in for registration and important service updates. Off by default.

Register a random installation ID and a private installation credential, device manufacturer/model, Android version and app version with the configured control service. Firebase App Check uses Google Play Integrity to verify the app; Firebase Messaging uses an installation token for updates. This is not proof of a unique physical device or a reinstall. No IMEI, MAC, media or download URLs are sent. Keyed abuse counters expire after 2 hours and challenge receipts after 24 hours; actual deletion may be delayed until server cleanup runs. General messages still use their separate choice, and Android notification permission remains separate. Disabling stops further registration and revokes push; existing registration statistics require the server retention/deletion policy. Production remains disabled until that policy and deployment are approved. Do you consent to this registration?
Registration is not configured, or its private state could not be safely saved. No fresh identity will replace damaged state.
